description: This is a Java source file for an Android application activity named 'ImagePixelization'. It implements image pixelization effects, incorporating both custom pixelation algorithms and built-in bitmap scaling methods, along with UI controls like SeekBar, menu options, and AsyncTask usage for background processing.

classes.name: ImagePixelization
classes.description: An Android activity demonstrating image pixelization techniques with UI controls and background processing.

methods.name: customImagePixelization
methods.description: Performs pixelization by averaging pixel colors within regions based on a pixelization factor.

methods.name: builtInPixelization
methods.description: Uses bitmap scaling to achieve pixelization with performance optimizations.

methods.name: invokePixelization
methods.description: Triggers pixelization either synchronously or via AsyncTask depending on user settings.

methods.name: pixelizeImage
methods.description: Chooses between different pixelization algorithms based on user preferences.
